nodes.title: SG-7.6 · Runner locking, timeout, retry, budget and approval gate unit tests
nodes.body:
Context: backend/worker/internal/runner/runner.go already implements the per-World lock, per-attempt timeout, retry loop, ErrBudgetExceeded and worktree cleanup, and many tests exist. Gaps: no exported ErrTimeout exists (a timeout surfaces only as context.DeadlineExceeded), and nothing proves a timed-out agent is retried once and then FAILED. Desired behavior: Run returns an error wrapping ErrTimeout when an attempt times out, and unit tests prove lock-held, timeout retry, MaxRetries exhaustion with single worktree removal, and budget stop. Why: the worker must fail predictably and never leave stray worktrees.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the lock file is already held, When Run is called, Then the error wraps lock.ErrLocked, the agent never runs and no worktree is created
- Given the agent blocks past Timeout and MaxRetries is 1, When Run is called, Then the agent runs twice, the stored status is FAILED and the error wraps ErrTimeout
- Given every attempt fails and MaxRetries is 2, When Run is called, Then the agent runs 3 times, the stored status is FAILED and the worktree is removed exactly once
- Given each failed attempt costs 3.0, MaxBudget is 5.0 and MaxRetries is 5, When Run is called, Then the error wraps ErrBudgetExceeded after 2 agent runs and the stored status is FAILED


## Scope
- In scope: backend/worker/internal/runner/runner.go ErrTimeout sentinel
- In scope: Runner unit tests with fake agent, worktrees, publisher, store in temp dir and fixed clock
- Out of scope: Real Git worktrees or real Claude CLI
- Out of scope: Approval gate behavior changes
- Out of scope: Other worker packages
- Preserve: Existing errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) behavior
- Preserve: Existing runner tests stay green
- Preserve: Budget check semantics (zero or negative budget unlimited)


## Technical constraints
- Go tests only, no network, no real processes
- Use existing fakes in runner_test.go (fakeAgent, fakeTrees, newRunner)


## Definition of done
- All four acceptance criteria are asserted by passing unit tests
- go test ./internal/runner passes


## Non-functional requirements
- Tests finish in under a second using a 20ms timeout


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · A timed-out agent attempt returns ErrTimeout and is retried then marked FAILED
nodes.body:
Context: runAttempt wraps each agent call in context.WithTimeout but the resulting error is a bare context.DeadlineExceeded. Desired: export ErrTimeout and wrap it (alongside DeadlineExceeded) when an attempt times out so callers and tests can identify it. Expected: with MaxRetries 1 the agent runs twice and the execution ends FAILED with ErrTimeout. Why: operators need a distinguishable timeout failure.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the agent blocks and Timeout is 20ms and MaxRetries is 1, When Run is called, Then agent.calls is 2
- Given the same setup, When Run returns, Then errors.Is(err, ErrTimeout) and errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) are both true and the stored status is FAILED
- Given the parent context is cancelled before timeout, When an attempt ends, Then the error does not wrap ErrTimeout


## Scope
- In scope: ErrTimeout var and wrapping in runAttempt
- Out of scope: Config changes
- Preserve: DeadlineExceeded still matches via errors.Is


## Technical constraints
- Go multiple %w wrapping already used in runner.go


## Definition of done
- ErrTimeout exported and wrapped only on attempt deadline


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Run stops after MaxRetries failures, marks FAILED and removes the worktree once
nodes.body:
Context: the loop in Runner.run breaks when attempt > MaxRetries, then saves FAILED and calls trees.Remove once. Desired: this is proven for MaxRetries 2 with the removal count asserted. Why: stray worktrees or double removal would corrupt later runs.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given MaxRetries is 2 and all calls fail, When Run is called, Then agent.calls is 3
- Given the same setup, When Run returns, Then the stored status is FAILED, the stored error contains the last error text and trees.removed has exactly one entry equal to WorkRoot/EXEC-1


## Scope
- In scope: Confirm retry loop and failure cleanup path in runner.go
- Out of scope: Backoff between retries
- Preserve: Failure path order: Save FAILED then Remove


## Definition of done
- Retry loop and cleanup verified unchanged and correct


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · A held lock blocks Run and exceeded budget stops retries with ErrBudgetExceeded
nodes.body:
Context: run acquires lock.Acquire before any state is written, and stops retrying once spent > MaxBudget. Desired: both are proven including that a held lock creates no worktree and no execution record, and that a budget stop persists FAILED and removes the worktree once. Why: protects the single-run-per-World guarantee and spend cap.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the lock file exists, When Run is called, Then errors.Is(err, lock.ErrLocked), agent.calls is 0, no worktree is created and store.Get(EXEC-1) fails
- Given cost 3.0, MaxBudget 5.0, MaxRetries 5 and all calls fail, When Run is called, Then the error wraps ErrBudgetExceeded, agent.calls is 2, stored status is FAILED and trees.removed has one entry


## Scope
- In scope: Confirm lock acquisition order and budget condition in runner.go
- Out of scope: Lock package internals
- Preserve: Lock released via defer


## Definition of done
- Lock-before-save order and budget condition verified correct


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Act: Export ErrTimeout and wrap it in runAttempt
nodes.body:
Add a package-level ErrTimeout next to ErrBudgetExceeded and make runAttempt wrap it with the original deadline error when the attempt context expired while the parent context is still live.

## Acceptance criteria
- runAttempt returns an error satisfying errors.Is for both ErrTimeout and context.DeadlineExceeded when the attempt deadline fires
- runAttempt does not add ErrTimeout when the parent ctx is already done


## Scope
- In scope: backend/worker/internal/runner/runner.go
- Out of scope: tests
- Preserve: Other error paths


## Technical constraints
- Keep Go signature of runAttempt unchanged
- Code path: `backend/worker/internal/runner/runner.go`


## Definition of done
- ErrTimeout declared with doc comment and applied in runAttempt
- go build ./... passes


## Clarifying questions
- None

steps.action: Declare exported sentinel ErrTimeout directly after ErrBudgetExceeded with a doc comment saying it is returned (wrapped) when one agent attempt exceeds Config.Timeout.
steps.code:
// ErrTimeout is returned (wrapped) when an agent attempt exceeds Config.Timeout.
var ErrTimeout = errors.New("runner: agent attempt timed out")
steps.expected: runner package exports ErrTimeout and compiles

steps.action: Keep the WithTimeout call, store the agent result in cost and err, and when err != nil and tctx.Err() is context.DeadlineExceeded and ctx.Err() == nil, return cost and fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", ErrTimeout, err); otherwise return cost, err unchanged.
steps.expected: Timed-out attempts wrap ErrTimeout and context.DeadlineExceeded
